svg.title: Habitus part-cards, 44 x 36 mm (A4) - print & cut
svg.desc: A4. Twenty-five part-cards, five per row. Cut along the gaps and slot them into the person board's five seats. The figure you build is the character sheet - nothing is written down. Every card carries the habitus tint #E8D4B8, which marks habitus everywhere it appears.
svg.text: Deal one card from each row, at random, and build the figure bottom to top. Nobody picks their upbringing.
CUT ALONG THE GAPS · DEAL, DON'T CHOOSE
the row you begin in on the Zone
your Torso is also your Need, from week 4

g.text: let me get on with it

svg.text: every part is a Hero trigger somewhere
ITEM · THE TOOL YOU HOLD → OVERTIME PICK
also the column you begin in on the Zone
Same skill, different person: two characters can both hold the clipboard. One defers to the boss without thinking; one doesn't.
That difference is the whole point - it is what the Torso and Head are for.
